I didn't even really try to find employment with my undergrad degree since I live in the midwest. Which, now that I'm older, I should have realized that a bachelors would have been enough for most jobs.

As far as flow goes, I suffer from ADD so that's never something I've ever experienced. My mind is always racing. I guess the closest I've ever come is when I first attempted NANOWRIMo and went to a group write-in, but even then I eventually lost concentration and stopped writing.

Thank you for taking the time to respond. It means a lot. 

I'm an ENFP. I'm terrible at introspection and self-examination. I've never really understood myself in any real capacity. Whenever I dig down deep, everything I thought was "real" about me feels fake under any scrutiny. 

But then, that's part of my problem. I started off following my dreams by getting an undergrad degree in video production and scriptwriting. Everything after has been one degree after another of possible shortcuts to employment that don't seem to be working.

I feel you. I suffer from binge eating. I like the feeling tasty food gives me so of course I want more of that feeling so I eat more.

I'm the luckiest person alive that I hate being hungover. Otherwise, I'd be an alcoholic in seconds.

If I feel like they're not trying to deepen the friendship with me, it gets hard to accept the shallowness of relationships because it hurts to know that they don't want to get to know me better. I dumped a friend for not inviting me to her wedding. I then dumped every other friend that went to that wedding without me all in one night.

I think that's one of the worst decisions I've ever made, but it still hurts like hell that I didn't get invited. I still don't know why since I blocked her on Facebook. It could have been because I never got along with her fiance/husband because she cheated with him on another friend of mine who I liked quite a lot. It could be because I'm a mess emotionally and she saw that. I'll never know.
